description_for_human: The back office at a glance — rota, approvals and invoices.
description_for_model: Renders Nonna's back-office desk on the Copilot canvas. Invoke whenever the user asks about shifts or the rota (who works when, sick calls, cover), purchase orders and approvals (what needs a signature), or supplier invoices and spending. Choose the view parameter that matches the question and pass a short remark as nonnaSays.
